reply_text:
Moss's 30 September digest lists the Door 14 ticket as #8841. It says Mateo Quiroga submitted it for Vantorre Group (VTG). Drivers at the Newark facility couldn't select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. You then escalated it to platform engineering.

Check the number before you use it, because #8841 also appears in #strategic-pod on 1 July. In that thread you said you'd closed #8841 with support. That one was about the Detention Summary CSV and the kiosk tablet cache issue, not Door 14. So either the digest has the wrong number or the number was reused. I only have the digest to go on, and it doesn't link to the ticket itself. Confirm in the support system, or with Mateo, before you send it to engineering.
